zg361_we_m253_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m253_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m253_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m253_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 253 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m253_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m253_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m253_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m253_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m253_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_record_recovery_response_253
				has_variable = zg361_we_m253_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m253_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m253_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ab_owner
			var:zg361_we_m253_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ab_subject
			var:zg361_we_m253_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m253_write_case = var:zg361_case_ab_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m253_write_state = var:zg361_case_ab_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m253_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_object_recovery_plan
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_resource_pip
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_resource_appeal
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_resource_manager_score
						}
					var:zg361_we_m253_object_type_code = 253
					var:zg361_we_m253_consumer_contract = 253
					var:zg361_we_m253_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m253_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m253_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m253_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m253_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m253_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m253_object_case = var:zg361_we_m253_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m253_object_state = var:zg361_we_m253_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m253_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_type_code = 253
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_consumer_contract = 253
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m253_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m253_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m253_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m253_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m253_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m253_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m253_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m253_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m253_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m253_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m253_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m253_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m253_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m253_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m253_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m253_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m253_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m253_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m253_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m253_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m253_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_record_recovery_response_253 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m253_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m253_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_consumer_record_recovery_response_253 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ab_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

							EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
							EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
							EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
							EXPECTED_STATE = 6
							EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
						}
					}
					OR = {
						zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
							RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_owner
							RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_subject
							RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_cycle
							RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_case
							RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_state
							RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_choice
							EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
							EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
							EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$

							EXPECTED_STATE = 6
							EXPECTED_CHOICE = 1
						}
						zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
							RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_owner
							RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_subject
							RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_cycle
							RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_case
							RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_state
							RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_choice

							EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2

						zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
							RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_owner
							RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_subject
							RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_cycle
							RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_case

							EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
							EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
							EXPECTED_STATE = 6
							EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
						}
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ab_s06_deadline_pending value = 0 }
				zg361_case_ab_advance_06_effect = {
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
					zg361_we_ac_launch_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ab_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ab_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 6
			}
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_cycle

						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 6

					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {

						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_case

						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

						EXPECTED_STATE = 6
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 6
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_operation_total
						has_variable = zg361_we_operation_used
					}
					var:zg361_we_operation_used < var:zg361_we_operation_total
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 2533 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } # typed RED, no receipt or business write
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ab_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ab_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 6
			}
			zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {

				RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_subject
				RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_cycle

				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 6
				EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 2 } # idempotent no-op
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ab_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ab_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$

			OR = {
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {

					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m253_receipt_subject

					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

					EXPECTED_STATE = 6

		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 2539 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } # route collision typed RED
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 3 } } # stale no-op
}
